packageRules.description: Group extension framework: WXT + Svelte, plus the vite toolchain they both peer on. Listed explicitly because packages:vite's `**vite-plugin**` glob doesn't cross the `/` in scoped names
wxt is 0.x so its minors are breaking. Approval is branch-wide, so this holds the whole extension framework PR whenever it carries a wxt minor
Group test tooling: packages:jsUnitTest covers vitest, @vitest/** and @testing-library/**; happy-dom is the vitest environment

Ship the changelog preset with the built-in semantic-release monorepo group. Capped <10: 10.x returns writer opts as `template` (conventional-changelog-writer v9), but release-notes-generator still depends on writer v8, which reads `mainTemplate`, so 10.x silently renders release notes with no commit sections. Lift the cap once release-notes-generator moves to writer v9.
Group GitHub Actions. depType `action` leaves out runner images (`runs-on`) and setup-node's `node-version`, which the same manager extracts
Node version updates keep existing precision (.nvmrc stays major.minor), no pinning to full patch
